context: Approval directly answers the published 29-action controls runtime, UI and persistence proposal at b3be02ae.

scope.scope: Remap the existing 21 project actions and eight named UI actions; add one accessible Controls panel and isolated version-1 preference document; support physical/logical keys with modifiers, mouse buttons, standardized joypad buttons and signed axes; gate capture/modal/text focus and update live binding prompts. Existing domain transitions and audio/art owners remain unchanged.

defaults.keyboard: Retain all exact 21 committed physical-key bindings; retain observed logical UI keys and Shift+Tab.
defaults.mouse: No gameplay mouse assignments by default; pointer hit testing/left-click Button.Pressed stays native.
defaults.controller: Add left-stick axes 0/1 and D-pad 13/14/11/12 to movement; Start (6) to optional overlays. UI directions retain observed stick/D-pad bindings; add A (0) accept, B (1) cancel, right shoulder (10) next, left shoulder (9) previous. Other 16 project commands begin unassigned on controller and remain remappable.

scope.new_uid_sidecars: Only Godot-generated .cs.uid/.gd.uid for the explicitly listed new scripts, if generated; include/hash exact sidecars.
excluded: art/audio sources, levels, admission or history owners
scope.completion_condition: Validated 29-action document and transactional adapter, usable Controls panel at both sizes with all three event classes, safe capture/reset/persistence/error behavior, unchanged existing transition qualification, focused unit/Godot/native/mounted-resource evidence and full root quality; retain physical-device limitations and close only this remapping slice.
scope.roadmap_completion_rule: Keep the Phase 11 controls checkbox unchecked until ordinary physical keyboard, mouse and named controller evidence establishes the supported device claim. This proposal and synthetic events cannot close that claim.

publication_authority: ALWAYS commit and push when you finish a task

verification_only_adjustments.reason: The unfrozen current input smoke assertion requires only Tab and two original callbacks. Approved defaults add controller Start; input handling and event unsubscription add Godot _Input/_ExitTree overrides. Require exact Tab plus Start, the four exact lifecycle callbacks and no public properties. No new public command/domain API, frozen validator/evidence or product scope expansion.
